_about: Fair Isaac (FICO) items that are not machine-extracted: FY26 guidance history, debt terms, buyback / ASR, restructuring, share price. Every item cites its EDGAR source (SEC EDGAR, CIK 814547). USD millions unless stated.

history.source: Q1 FY26 release (8-K Ex. 99.1): guidance reiterated

guidance_fy26.note: Point guidance (no ranges). The company gives no segment, margin, tax-rate, interest, capex or cash-flow guidance; FY26 ended 30-Sep-2026 and Q4 FY26 had not been reported at the build date (13-Oct-2026).

restructuring_oct2026.text: Workforce reduction of ~15% of positions (fewer layers, simpler operating structure, AI-driven product development); ~$27.0m pre-tax charges in Q4 FY26, substantially all cash; plan substantially complete by end of Q3 FY27. Announced after the 29-Jul-2026 guidance; restructuring is excluded from FICO's non-GAAP measures.

debt_2026_06_30.source: Q3 FY26 10-Q Note 6 (Debt) and MD&A Capital Resources, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/814547/000081454726000030/fico-20260630.htm; 8-K 5-Jun-2026 (term loan); 8-Ks 11-Mar-2026 (2026 Senior Notes pricing)

term_loan.amortization: $75.0m per quarter 30-Sep-2026 to 30-Jun-2027, then $112.5m per quarter; balance due 15-May-2028

debt_2026_06_30.repaid: 2018 Senior Notes ($400m, 5.25%, due May-2026) redeemed 26-Mar-2026 from the 2026 Senior Notes proceeds
debt_2026_06_30.covenant: Maximum consolidated leverage ratio 4.5x through 30-Dec-2026, 4.0x 31-Dec-2026 to 30-Dec-2027, 3.5x thereafter (credit agreement definition)

buyback.source: Q3 FY26 10-Q Note 7 and Part II Item 2
buyback.program: June 2026 program: $2.0bn, open-ended; $800.0m remaining at 30-Jun-2026 including the $300.0m ASR prepayment not yet delivered in shares

asr.settlement: expected in Q4 FY26 (shares based on VWAP over the term less a discount)

shares.source: Q3 FY26 10-Q balance sheet parenthetical and cover page

dividends: Quarterly dividend of $0.02 per share paid through FY2017; none since (cash-flow statements).

price.source: User-provided share price for this build (13-Oct-2026). Not an SEC-sourced figure: update to market. For reference, the Q3 FY26 10-Q Part II Item 2 average repurchase price was $1,148.84 (Apr-Jun 2026).
